crossRefs.note: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet…
Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah, saying,
“Thus has Yahweh of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his…
But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did, when he was hungry, and those who were with him;
He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.
translations.bsb: And when Moses heard this explanation, he was satisfied.
translations.kjv: And when Moses heard that, he was content.
translations.asv: And when Moses heard that, it was well-pleasing in his sight.
